source: REAL batch-4 D48 Q2 runs (2026-11-02, averi-lab iPhone 17 simulator, iOS 27.0, WDA tree source): Contacts in front, then averi's launch_app dev.averi.lab and the ui_snapshot right after it, through the MCP tools. `before` is the src before D48's fix (9d8b57dc), `main` after it (7e6d2d47). Per run: the launch's reply and its ms, the snapshot's ms, the root label the harness read off the snapshot, whether it was the lab's tree, whether the reply warned, and how many /wda/activeAppInfo asks the launch made. `treeHead` is the snapshot reply as the harness kept it, cut by the harness after its first characters (the whole trees were not kept). Paths and the udid dropped; nothing else changed.
